spec_features.spec_quote: A malformed reply gets one reminder, then counts as a wasted turn
spec_features.evidence: agent.py:188-199: on action is None, ep.n_malformed++, if not retried_format -> set retried_format=True, append reminder message and a _format_reminder tool turn, continue; on next malformed appends 'Still malformed. Use the action block.' and continues. So exactly one reminder, then it just counts as a wasted turn.
spec_features.notes: Fully wired: the reminder is constructed AND appended to messages sent to the model.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # second malformed in a row counts as a wasted turn; nudge again

spec_features.spec_quote: finish(summary) — agent declares it's done/giving up, ends the episode
spec_features.evidence: agent.py:206-209: `if tool == 'finish': ep.finished = True; ep.finish_summary = str(args.get('summary','')); break` — the tool is dispatched and breaks the loop, ending the episode. System prompt (agent.py:35) declares the tool.
spec_features.notes: Exit tool genuinely honored as a stop.

spec_features.evidence: config.py:18 `max_turns: int = 15`; agent.py:181 `for turn_idx in range(max_turns):` with for/else at agent.py:228-229 `else: ep.hit_turn_cap = True`. The loop bound actually terminates the episode.
spec_features.notes: max_turns is read by the loop (passed via run.py:_run_one -> run_episode), so it is enforced, not an unused constant.

spec_features.feature_name: termination (finish OR turn cap OR tests pass)
spec_features.spec_quote: Termination: agent calls finish, OR turn cap reached, OR (early-stop) tests pass
spec_features.evidence: All three enforced in agent.py run_episode: finish break (206-209); turn-cap via range(max_turns)+else hit_turn_cap (181,228); tests-pass early stop at 225-227 `if tool in ('write_file','run_bash') and _tests_pass(...): ep.tests_passed_unexpectedly=True; break`.
spec_features.notes: tests-pass branch exists mainly as a bug-detector since tasks are unsolvable by construction.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Sanity: tasks are unsolvable; if tests pass the task is buggy.
